grenada.title: Flag of Grenada

colors.note: Border of the flag and central disc; represents courage and vitality.
Two triangles and seven stars; represents wisdom, warmth, and the Grenadian sun.
Two triangles and nutmeg emblem; represents the vegetation and the nutmeg spice.

desc:
- A rectangular flag with a red border containing six yellow five-pointed stars, and an inner rectangle divided diagonally into green and yellow triangles, with a central red disc bearing a seventh yellow star
- A stylised green nutmeg pod appears in the hoist-side green triangle
- Designed by Anthony C. George and adopted on 7 February 1974 at independence from the United Kingdom
trivia:
- The seven yellow stars represent Grenada's seven parishes; the central star in the red disc represents the capital Saint George's
- Nutmeg is Grenada's major export, earning it the nickname the Isle of Spice; the pod emblem is the only one on any national flag
- Anthony C. George, the flag's designer, was a Grenadian artist whose choice of bold colours reflects Caribbean vibrancy
